product.name: orin
product.what_it_is: whole-disk instant file search for Windows

surfaces.orin query: one-shot search; JSON Lines with --json; exit codes 0 results, 1 no match, 2 error
surfaces.orin status: daemon health: entries, roots, memory, progress
surfaces.orin tui: interactive picker; prints the selected path to stdout on Enter
surfaces.orin mcp: MCP server on stdio: tools find, stat, status
surfaces.orin daemon: runs the resident indexer; auto-spawned on first use
surfaces.on: argv[0] alias: on foo == orin query foo

measured.basis: GitHub Actions windows-latest runners, 25,926-entry deterministic corpus
